The bill explicitly addresses both veterinarians and veterinary technicians, directly impacting the scope of practice for paraprofessionals in delivering remote veterinary services.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses veterinary paraprofessional scope of practice by specifying which services veterinary technicians and technologists must be licensed to perform and which services are restricted to licensed veterinarians. It also establishes that veterinarians are responsible for supervising all services performed by these paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands the veterinary paraprofessional workforce by establishing registration and regulatory oversight for veterinary professional associates (VPA), a new or expanded category. It also modifies telehealth prescription rules and creates public registry requirements for VPA registrants.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes the Veterinary Professional Associate (VPA) as a new paraprofessional role with defined scope of practice and registration requirements. It sets regulatory standards for VPA certification, supervision, and discipline through the Department of Business and Professional Regulation and Board of Veterinary Medicine.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly regulates the veterinary technician workforce by establishing licensure requirements, defining scope of practice, setting continuing education standards, and clarifying what tasks supervising veterinarians can delegate to licensed technicians. It also addresses title protection and disciplinary actions for both licensed and unlicensed technicians and veterinary assistants.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Service Animals In Insurance Underwriting, The Appointment Of An Advocate In Proceedings Concerning The Welfare Or Custody Of Companion Animals, Assault Of A Domestic Animal And Establishing An Animal Abuse Task Force.
bills.last_action: Favorable Change of Reference, Senate to Committee on Judiciary
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes an animal abuse task force and expands legal protections for animals, which creates potential demand for veterinary paraprofessionals to document injuries, provide expert testimony, and participate in animal welfare investigations. The appointment of animal advocates in custody proceedings may require veterinary paraprofessionals' involvement in assessing animal health and welfare conditions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands veterinary service access by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and enabling telehealth for urgent care. While primarily focused on veterinarians, it indirectly affects paraprofessional workforce by potentially changing supervision requirements and practice settings where veterinary technicians and assistants work.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill restricts veterinary care providers from advertising or promoting medical credit cards to consumers and prohibits charging for veterinary services before they are provided. It applies to all veterinary professionals who provide direct care or billing services to animal patients.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill concerns the continuation of licensing requirements for pet animal care facilities under state agricultural oversight. It implements recommendations from a 2025 sunset review that may affect regulations governing facility operations and the paraprofessionals who work within them.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill aims to increase access to veterinary care by streamlining veterinarian licensing through endorsement and clarifying regulations around prescription and compounded drug use. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensure and drug authorization, it directly impacts paraprofessionals by defining the scope of veterinary services available and the regulatory framework within which technicians and assistants work.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.
bills.last_action: Read second time. Ordered to third reading.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine laws by modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code related to veterinary practice. The amendments affect licensure requirements, scope of practice, supervision standards, and professional qualifications for veterinary professionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Criminal history information: background checks.
bills.last_action: In Senate. Read first time. To Com. on RLS. for assignment.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends criminal history background check requirements across multiple professions and industries. It likely impacts veterinary paraprofessionals who may be subject to criminal background checks for licensure, employment, or working with vulnerable populations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which is a critical concern in veterinary medicine. Veterinary paraprofessionals play a key role in implementing antimicrobial stewardship protocols, proper medication handling, and client education regarding appropriate antibiotic use in animal care settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine laws to regulate cat declawing procedures. It directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals by defining which procedures they can and cannot perform, as declawing involves surgical intervention that may be restricted to veterinarians only.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends the Business and Professions Code to define and regulate the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants in California. It establishes what tasks and procedures these paraprofessionals are authorized to perform under veterinary supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends regulations regarding the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which is a foundational legal and professional requirement that directly governs what tasks veterinarians can delegate to paraprofessionals and under what conditions. Changes to VCPR requirements will impact the scope of practice and supervision requirements for all veterinary paraprofessional roles.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 195, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This California bill comprehensively amends the Veterinary Medical Board regulations across multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code, addressing veterinary practice standards, licensure requirements, and professional conduct. The amendments likely impact scope of practice, supervision requirements, and regulatory oversight that directly affect veterinary paraprofessional roles and their work relationships with licensed veterinarians.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act For The Department Of Education - Division Of Higher Education Appropriation For The 2026-2027 Fiscal Year.
bills.last_action: Notification that SB58 is now Act 138
bills.summary_ai: This appropriations bill for higher education funding in FY 2026-2027 is relevant to veterinary paraprofessional workforce development as it determines budget allocation for educational programs that train veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and other paraprofessionals. The funding levels directly impact the capacity and quality of veterinary paraprofessional education programs offered through higher education institutions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary practices; ownership; oversight
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses ownership and oversight of veterinary practices, which directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals are employed, supervised, and regulated within practice settings. Ownership structure determines management authority and can affect scope of practice delegation and supervision requirements for paraprofessional staff.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; education alternative; certifications
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses veterinary technician education pathways and certification requirements, creating alternative routes for individuals to become certified veterinary technicians. It directly impacts credentialing and qualification standards for veterinary paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
bills.last_action: House LARA Committee action: Held, voting: (0-0-0-0-0-0)
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses certification and education pathways for veterinary technicians, establishing alternative routes to achieve professional credentials. It directly impacts how veterinary technicians can qualify and practice in the profession.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Statewide Spay & Neuter Program
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a statewide spay and neuter assistance program and fund, which directly impacts the volume and availability of spay/neuter procedures performed in veterinary clinics. The program's implementation will likely increase demand for veterinary paraprofessionals who assist with or perform these surgical procedures under veterinary supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary licensing permits for regulated professions, which could directly impact veterinary paraprofessionals who may need to work under temporary credentials during licensing transitions, education completion, or emergency staffing situations. The legislation may establish pathways for provisional or temporary practice authorization for veterinary technicians, assistants, and other paraprofessional roles.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Extnd Bds:midwive/nursing/vet Exam/parole
bills.last_action: EFFECTIVE DATE(S) OF LAW SEE CHAPTER
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends the termination date of the Board of Veterinary Examiners, which is the regulatory body responsible for overseeing veterinary professionals including paraprofessionals. The extension ensures continued governance and oversight of veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and other paraprofessional categories through the licensing and examination board.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary licensing permits for regulated professions, which could directly impact veterinary paraprofessionals who need to practice while obtaining full licensure or credentials. Temporary permits are commonly used to allow veterinary technicians and other paraprofessionals to work during examination windows or credential transitions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Disaster Emergency Plan For Pets
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a disaster emergency plan for pets and service animals that involves veterinarians and veterinarian technicians in emergency response coordination. The legislation creates requirements for emergency planning at state and local levels, potentially expanding roles for veterinary paraprofessionals in disaster preparedness and response activities.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Emergency Med Svcs; Operational Canines
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses emergency medical services for operational canines and modifies veterinary practice laws, including the powers and duties of veterinarians and their liability. It may expand or clarify the scope of practice for veterinary professionals in emergency/trauma situations involving working dogs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Health care; allied health professionals, training; tuition grants and loan forgiveness; Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund created
bills.last_action: Pending House Ways and Means General Fund
bills.summary_ai: This bill creates funding mechanisms through the Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund to support tuition grants and loan forgiveness for allied health professionals, including veterinary paraprofessionals, working in rural areas. The legislation aims to expand and retain the veterinary workforce in underserved rural regions through financial incentives.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine; veterinarian-client-patient relationship further specified; scope of practice inside and outside veterinarian-client-patient relationship further defined
bills.summary_ai: This bill clarifies the veterinarian-client-patient relationship and defines the scope of practice for veterinarians both within and outside this relationship. These definitions directly impact what tasks veterinary paraprofessionals can perform under veterinary supervision and delegation.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
